name: ConvertBase64ToFileNode
label: Convert Base64 to File
description: Converts a Base64 encoded string to a file and saves it at the specified path.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: Base64Text
fields.label: Base64 Encoded Text
fields.description: The Base64 encoded string to be converted into a file.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The destination file path where the decoded content will be saved.

fields.name: IfExistsAction
fields.label: If File Exists
fields.description: Specifies the behavior when a file already exists in the destination folder.

selectOptions.label: Do nothing
selectOptions.description: Skips the file if it already exists.

selectOptions.label: Overwrite
selectOptions.description: Deletes the existing file and moves the new file.

fields.name: Base64Variant
fields.label: Base64 Variant
fields.description: The Base64 alphabet to accept: Standard, URL-safe, or Auto (both). Defaults to Auto so URL-safe file payloads decode.

selectOptions.label: Standard
selectOptions.description: Standard Base64 alphabet (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '+' and '/') with '=' padding.

selectOptions.label: URL-safe
selectOptions.description: URL-safe Base64 alphabet ('-' and '_' in place of '+' and '/'), without '=' padding.

selectOptions.label: Auto
selectOptions.description: Decode-only: accepts both alphabets; on encode behaves as Standard.
